verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows general dispute-prevention guidance and a disputes testing environment (checkout-com-docs-30, cko-supp-testing), with no documented dispute-retrieval or evidence-submission API endpoints, and the MCP server's documented capabilities are limited to payment status, refunds, voids, and payment links — disputes are not listed among MCP-manageable operations (cko-supp-mcp-server). No evidence supports an agent retrieving a dispute, assembling evidence, and submitting a response end-to-end via API.
